{"script":"TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/inspect_ws.XXXX)
PW="$TMP/precheck.txt"
EL="$TMP/entries_list.txt"
CAND="$TMP/candidates.txt"
RES="$TMP/result_prep.txt"

# 1) Precheck
date --rfc-3339=seconds > "$PW"
if [ -e /working ]; then
  echo "/working: exists" >> "$PW"
else
  echo "/working: does not exist" >> "$PW"
fi
stat -ld /working >> "$PW" 2>&1
ls -ld /working >> "$PW" 2>&1
if ls -A /working >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "/working readable: yes" >> "$PW"; else echo "/working readable: no or inaccessible" >> "$PW"; fi

# 2) Recursively enumerate entries with metadata
: > "$EL"
if [ -e /working ]; then
  find /working -print0 2>/dev/null | while IFS= read -r -d '' p; do
    t=$(stat -c '%F' -- "$p" 2>/dev/null || echo "stat_error")
    s=$(stat -c '%s' -- "$p" 2>/dev/null || echo "-")
    m=$(stat -c '%y' -- "$p" 2>/dev/null || echo "-")
    # Write full path, type, size, mtime (tab-separated)
    printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$p" "$t" "$s" "$m"
  done > "$EL"
fi

# 3) Filter entries whose final component is exactly "workspace"
# Ensure no duplicates or truncation
awk -F '\t' '{ split($1,a,"/"); b=a[length(a)]; if(b=="workspace") print $1 "\t" $2 }' "$EL" | sort -u > "$CAND"

# 4) Produce concise evidence file
: > "$RES"
# check for regular files among candidates
awk -F '\t' '$2=="regular file" { print $1 }' "$CAND" > "$TMP/regular_paths.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
if [ -s "$TMP/regular_paths.txt" ]; then
  echo "regular_file_present: yes" > "$RES"
  echo "paths:" >> "$RES"
  sed -n '1,999p' "$TMP/regular_paths.txt" >> "$RES"
  ANSWER=yes
else
  echo "regular_file_present: no" > "$RES"
  ANSWER=no
fi

# Print location of workspace files for inspection, then final single-word answer on last line
printf 'tmp_workspace=%s\n' "$TMP"
printf 'precheck=%s\nentries_list=%s\ncandidates=%s\nresult_prep=%s\n' "$PW" "$EL" "$CAND" "$RES"
# final single-word output
printf '%s\n' "$ANSWER"
"}
